environment: Distributed AWS EKS (Target: 20x c6i.4xlarge, 40x c6i.2xlarge generators)
limitations: AWS live distributed deployment requires external AWS cloud credentials and billing account.
Single-host Windows local dev environment reaches physical OS socket buffer limit (WSAENOBUFS 10055) under high concurrency.
Theoretical capacity model (500K active VUs / 270k RPS) is mathematically verified and IaC ready, but cloud physical execution is classified as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
